newsitem.title: UK: Buyers sidelined in Europe cotton.
newsitem.headline: Buyers sidelined in Europe cotton.

text.p: European cotton buyers kept to the sidelines and business was dull despite somewhat easier international shipment values.

Markets including Portugal, Italy and Turkey saw sporadic short-term demand for medium/better qualities. Eastern European msrkets seemed little changed although Romania and Poland noted some buying interest mainly in available Central Asian styles. The long staple sector was neglected.
